results.question: How many hours per week are employees expected to work?

expected_pages.source: Enterprise HR and IT Policy Document.pdf

results.answer: Employees are expected to work 40 hours per week [Source: Enterprise HR and IT Policy Document.pdf, page: 1].

results.question: What are the standard working hours from Monday through Friday?

expected_pages.source: Enterprise HR and IT Policy Document.pdf

results.answer: Standard working hours are from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Monday through Friday [Source: Enterprise HR and IT Policy Document.pdf, page: 1].

results.question: During what time range may flexible working hours be permitted with manager approval?

expected_pages.source: Enterprise HR and IT Policy Document.pdf

results.answer: Flexible working hours may be permitted between 8:00 AM and 6:00 PM with manager approval [Source: Enterprise HR and IT Policy Document.pdf, page: 1].

results.question: Who must approve overtime in advance?

expected_pages.source: Enterprise HR and IT Policy Document.pdf

results.answer: Overtime must be approved in advance by the employee’s direct supervisor [Source: Enterprise HR and IT Policy Document.pdf, page: 1]. All overtime requires advance approval [Source: employee-handbook-01.pdf, page: 17].

results.question: How many days per week may employees work remotely?

expected_pages.source: Enterprise HR and IT Policy Document.pdf

results.answer: Employees are allowed to work remotely up to 2 days per week [Source: Enterprise HR and IT Policy Document.pdf, page: 1].

results.question: What secure connection must employees use to access internal resources remotely?

expected_pages.source: Enterprise HR and IT Policy Document.pdf

results.answer: Employees must connect through the company VPN when accessing internal resources remotely [Source: Enterprise HR and IT Policy Document.pdf, page: 1].

results.question: How many paid vacation days are employees entitled to each year?

expected_pages.source: Enterprise HR and IT Policy Document.pdf

results.answer: The provided document passages do not specify the exact number of paid vacation days employees are entitled to each year. The text indicates that a number should be inserted into the policy regarding paid time off eligibility and accrual [Source: employee-handbook-01.pdf, page: 19].

results.question: How far in advance must vacation requests be submitted?

expected_pages.source: Enterprise HR and IT Policy Document.pdf

results.answer: Vacation requests must be submitted at least 2 weeks in advance through the company HR system [Source: Enterprise HR and IT Policy Document.pdf, page: 1]. Additionally, requests for time off should be forwarded in advance to a supervisor [Source: employee-handbook-01.pdf, page: 19].

results.question: Within how many hours must sick leave be reported?

expected_pages.source: Enterprise HR and IT Policy Document.pdf

results.answer: Sick leave must be reported within 24 hours [Source: Enterprise HR and IT Policy Document.pdf, page: 2].

results.question: When may a medical certificate be required for an absence?

expected_pages.source: Enterprise HR and IT Policy Document.pdf

results.answer: A medical certificate may be required for absences longer than 3 consecutive days [Source: Enterprise HR and IT Policy Document.pdf, page: 2].

results.question: Who must be notified of a suspected data breach or security incident?

expected_pages.source: Enterprise HR and IT Policy Document.pdf

results.answer: Any data breach or suspected security incident must be reported immediately to the IT department [Source: Enterprise HR and IT Policy Document.pdf, page: 2].
